stem: Pinecast has a DynamoDB table with hot read keys during live events and needs lower read latency and lower read-capacity overprovisioning.

choices.text: Move the table to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
Use AWS Storage Gateway file cache as the primary key-value acceleration layer.
Add a DynamoDB Accelerator cluster in front of the table.
Replace the table with Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 readers only.

rationale: DAX is DynamoDB-compatible, designed for microsecond eventually consistent reads, and can reduce read-capacity overprovisioning. S3 Glacier is archival storage, not low-latency key-value serving. Aurora readers are relational and not a direct DynamoDB cache substitute. Storage Gateway file caching targets file or hybrid storage patterns, not DynamoDB API acceleration.
